states.truth: Ring is detached from ribbon and visible deeper beneath the wooden brace only at the tilted collection camera; it remains unreachable by fingers.

states.truth: After explicit recovery gives the ring, the cavity no longer contains it. Ribbon and existing loose upholstery remain; no new damage is invented.
